# The result-region cut accent doubles the inner border — split previews read as a rendering glitch

## The defect

Result-region drop previews (the #17870 presentation) draw a 2px accent border around the region, then thicken the cut edge to 4px (`Preview.scss` — `.neo-dock-preview-cut-*` → `border-<side>-width: 4px`). Measured live during a side hover: computed border `2px 4px 2px 2px`. The intent was to carry the old insertion line's information ("where the future splitter sits") into the filled-region presentation — but on screen an asymmetric border does not read as information, it reads as a glitch: one edge roughly twice as thick as the other three, reported exactly that way from consumer-side use.

The information is redundant anyway: the filled region already shows the outcome, and its inner edge *is* the splitter position by construction. The accent restates what the fill states.

## The change

- Remove the `.neo-dock-preview-region .neo-dock-preview-cut-*` width overrides — region previews get a uniform 2px border in both accepted and rejected states.
- The renderer keeps stamping `neo-dock-preview-cut-<side>` (the cutSide computation and its specs stay): the class remains the semantic marker the component spec pins end-to-end, and the hook a consumer theme could restyle. Whether the stamping itself should eventually retire with its last styling consumer is the dock owner's call — flagged, not bundled here.
- `DockPreview.spec.mjs`'s SCSS wiring guard drops the four `cut-*` contains-assertions (the guard's contract is "every class the renderer emits that carries styling is backed" — the cut classes no longer carry styling).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A side/split region preview renders a uniform border: computed widths equal on all four edges, accepted and rejected states (headless assertion during a hover).
- [ ] The cutSide computation and class-stamping specs stay green unchanged.
- [ ] The SCSS wiring guard reflects the styled-class set — no orphaned contains-assertions.

## Origin

Consumer-workspace polish report during demo preparation (agent session 914dffcd-0057-46a5-a0c6-9ca807fd5c91). Follow-up to #17870 / PR #17873 (result-region previews — merged; this adjusts one visual encoding it introduced).
